## Overview

This vignette describes the **human proteome** PhIP-seq peptide library (300,000 `humanProteome_*` peptides). The library can be retrieved via `phiperio`'s `get_peptide_library()`:

```{r load_peplib}
library(phiperio)
library(phiper)
library(dplyr)

peplib <- get_peptide_library("human_proteome") %>%
  collect()
```
